We need to produce test cases for focal method fetchSubSchemaNode. Identify all possible exception scenarios not covered yet. Existing test cases cover:

- suppressSubSchemaRetrieval true -> returns null (not exception)
- suppressSubSchemaRetrieval false normal case returns JsonSchema
- null ValidationContext -> NullPointerException (exception)
- schemaNode boolean true -> returns JsonSchema (not exception)
- empty object schemaNode -> returns JsonSchema (not exception)
- null schemaNode -> NullPointerException (exception)
- $ref resolution -> returns JsonSchema (not exception)
- validationContext factory exception -> RuntimeException (exception)

Potential other exception scenarios:

- suppressSubSchemaRetrieval false but obtainSubSchemaNode may throw IllegalArgumentException for unsupported schema node type (e.g., array node, number node, etc.)? Need to look at obtainSubSchemaNode implementation. Not provided, but typical behavior: if schemaNode is not an object or boolean, may throw IllegalArgumentException. So test with schemaNode being a numeric literal (e.g., JsonNodeFactory.instance.numberNode(5)). Expect IllegalArgumentException.

- schemaNode being an array node (e.g., JsonNodeFactory.instance.arrayNode().add(...)). Possibly same exception.

- ValidationContext with null schemaFactory (maybe builder allows null). If schemaFactory null, obtainSubSchemaNode may cause NullPointerException when trying to use it. So test with ValidationContext having null schemaFactory.

- ValidationContext with null uriFactory? Might cause NullPointerException when resolving $ref. Already have $ref case with proper factories. So test $ref with missing uriFactory causing IllegalArgumentException.

- suppressSubSchemaRetrieval flag is not set? That's a field, but we can test default value? Not needed.

- If schemaNode contains $ref that points to non-existent definition -> maybe throws JsonSchemaException or IllegalArgumentException. So test unresolved $ref.

- If schemaNode contains $ref that points to external URI and the factory cannot fetch -> maybe throws JsonSchemaException or RuntimeException. Could test external $ref with missing resource.

- If schemaNode is boolean false (false schema) - should return JsonSchema that always fails? Not exception. But maybe obtainSubSchemaNode returns a schema that always fails; not exception.

- If schemaNode is a text node (string) - invalid schema type, should cause IllegalArgumentException.

Thus we need to add test groups for these exception scenarios.

We must avoid duplication with existing test cases. So new groups:

- fetchSubSchemaNode - unsupported schema node type (numeric literal)
- fetchSubSchemaNode - unsupported schema node type (array node)
- fetchSubSchemaNode - ValidationContext with null schemaFactory
- fetchSubSchemaNode - $ref to missing definition (unresolved reference)
- fetchSubSchemaNode - $ref external unresolved (maybe same as above)

We need to produce JSON array of groups with cases.

Each case includes input parameters: validationContext, suppressSubSchemaRetrieval, schemaNode (when needed). Since method signature only takes ValidationContext, but fields suppressSubSchemaRetrieval and schemaNode are class fields, tests must set those via constructing a subclass or using reflection. In test case representation we can include them as parameters for clarity. Existing test cases include them.

Thus produce groups accordingly.
